annotation.justification: The clause states a clear condition—if no use of the codepoint was identified and no request was made to update the registration—then the codepoint MAY be removed. The wording does not permit two materially different implementation behaviours nor does it omit a concrete constraint that would change the operational interpretation. Therefore the clause is not ambiguous.
